name: Deathbane Crescent (Greater)
text:
This crescent moon carved out of bone holds the power to turn back the undead. This spellheart covers any item it's affixed to with spiderwebs that reappear even if damaged or removed. The spell DC of any spell cast by Activating this item is 24.
- Armor After you cast a vitality spell by Activating the crescent, you gain resistance 5 to attacks and effects from undead creatures until the end of your next turn.

- Weapon After you cast a vitality spell by Activating the crescent, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d6 vitality damage until the end of your next turn.

Effect: Deathbane Crescent - Weapon

DC 24 basic Fortitude save
